'''Steven Schweickart B-Wing Invasion''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Steven Schweickart]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls80.htm B-Wing Invasion], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001216164600/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls80.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
